essence: The practitioner offers inner recitation and reverence to primordial Kali.
After completing inner worship, the practitioner should begin external worship.
Reciting the formula in this way is traditionally known as the natural-order recitation.
The letter kṣa is designated as the meru of the rosary.
Immediately after this, the practitioner must use the mantra that will be stated.
